_about.what: The parts on each card, for the model (blender/scripts/build_m1_card_cage.py). Taken from research/data/card_layouts.json, which has the method, every uncertainty and the Rev 0 extras.
_about.revision: The CPU and 1K memory cards are the revision MITS's 1:1 X1 artwork shows (positions measured to about 0.02 in, facts only, never traced). The Rev 0 boards in the photos have a few extra parts (an extra 14-pin chip on each, the CPU's paper-wrapped crystal and some electrolytics); they are left out here so that the model is one real board, not a mixture (design/m1-notes.md). The 88-4MCS, 88-SIO and 88-2SIO come from photos (about 0.1 in).
_about.frame: Card frame, inches. Origin = front-bottom corner of the card body (front = the end 1.5 in from the tab). u along the card toward the rear (0-10), v up from the bottom edge of the body (0-5); the tab hangs below v=0 (u 1.43-7.92 on the CPU). Positions are seen on the component (silkscreen) side, which faces the right side of the box.
_about.parts: u,v = centre of the part footprint (for DIPs: centre of the pin grid). len = size along the long axis, wid = across; rot 0 = long axis along u, rot 90 = long axis along v. height = estimated top of the part above the board surface (height_conf est unless stated). pins = pin count (DIPs: verified on the copper for artwork parts).
